description: Na₃Sc₂(MoO₄)₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.44 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.71 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.97 Å. Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MoO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ScO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.23 Å. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent ScO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 59-61°. All Mo-O bond lengths are 1.87 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent ScO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-61°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-1.94 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Sc and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one Mo atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sc, and one Mo atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and one Mo atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂ScMo tetrahedra.
